_doc: Kid-friendly Chinese sentences for pinyin typing practice. Each entry pairs an array of characters (the Chinese sentence) with the matching pinyin syllables (lowercase, no tone marks — these are what the kid types). The optional `toned` array carries the same syllables with tone marks (wǒ, ài, mā, ma — display-only, helps the kid learn tones while only typing letters). All arrays MUST be the same length; one cell may hold either a single hanzi (e.g. "猫") or a contiguous group that shares one pinyin reading. Punctuation can be carried in the characters array as a standalone cell with the empty string "" as its pinyin — it renders as-is but contributes no keystrokes. Sample seed; expand by appending to entries[].
